blocks.raw: <Tip>The building permit process per PD 1096 is a regulatory gate. Incomplete or non-conforming submissions cause delays. As-built drawings and punch list documentation protect the owner's legal position and warranty claims. Never allow occupancy without final occupancy permit (CO) from LBO—liability falls on the builder and owner if code violations are discovered post-occupancy.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <WikiMistakeCard title="Proceeding Without Building Permit" body="A contractor begins construction without waiting for building permit approval to accelerate schedule. The LBO discovers unpermitted work and orders demolition. Project suffers complete loss. PD 1096 requires permits; violation is criminal." />
